messages:
marta: Uploaded a fresh PRD draft for the combined chat/completions + embeddings + rerank flow. Please read acceptance criteria and edge cases. Link: https://redwood.internal/prd/2026-03-combined-rerank-emb.json

alex: skimmed. Need concrete latency SLOs per path (streaming vs non-streaming) and an explicit overload plan (quantized fallback, queueing).

julia: embedding decision: target dim=2048 (OpenLong v3) as primary, but support legacy 1536 via a compatibility flag. Outputs must be L2-normalized and stable across releases (float32) for deterministic nearest-neighbor results.

suresh: migration caution: changing KV/prefix layout will cause cache churn for Dedicated customers. We need a migration document + a cache-warming strategy and dedicated canary clusters.

deploy-bot: CI report: pr-1492 tests passed except integration/large-batch-embeddings flaky. Requeued job-10112.

marta: Proposed acceptance criteria (high-level):
- Chat/completions: streaming enabled, TTFB(stream) < 150ms, token p50 < 60ms, p95 < 220ms for hosted tier.
- Embeddings: primary dim=2048, L2-normalized, mean embedding drift <= 0.015 vs baseline on 10k seed prompts (eval harness).
- Rerank: top_k <= 40, deterministic ordering with tie-breaker (model score -> recency -> stable doc_id hash), MRR uplift >= 10% on customer benchmark set.
- Fallbacks: on overload route -> quantized variant (flagged) or queue with backpressure header. If no fallback available, return 503 with JSON {"error":"model_unavailable","fallback_recommended":true}.
- Rollout: canary 1% for 48h, ramp 1%->5%->20%->100% with monitoring gates; auto-rollback on metrics breach.

alex: API contract suggestion for rerank (minimal):
```
POST /v1/rerank
{ "model":"rw-rerank-v2", "query":"...", "candidates":[{"id":"d1","text":"..."}, ...], "top_k": 10 }

response: { "scores":[{"id":"d1","score":0.823}], "ordering":["d3","d1",...], "model_version":"rw-rerank-v2@2026-03-18" }
```

julia: Edge-case list to add to PRD: empty candidates -> 400 with helpful message; candidates>40 -> 413 or auto-truncate and include `x-truncated` header; identical scores -> apply stable doc_id hash tie-breaker; extremely long candidate text -> truncate at 12k chars and surface `truncated:true` per-item.

suresh: Rollout/migration plan sketch:
1) deploy to isolated canary (no production traffic) and run replayed traffic.
2) 1% canary (48h) with isolated cache namespace.
3) 5% (24h) -> 20% (24h) -> 100% with background prefix warmers and KV-migration job.
4) rollback window 24h after each step.

marta: Testing notes: add deterministic ordering test that runs the same candidate set across multiple replicas and seeds in CI; add embedding-drift check in eval-harness with alert threshold 0.015; create a 5k anonymized prompt set for quality gating.

alex: Ops ask: add telemetry hooks for per-token latency histograms, per-model QPS, rerank score distribution, embedding vector norm histograms, and per-tenant embedding quotas to throttle noisy tenants.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued: job-10112. Will post status here when done.

julia: Also add a CI conformance test that asserts float32 reproducibility for embeddings across our runtime builds. Previous flakiness suggests bit-rot risk.

marta: Next steps: alex to update API contract + add overload semantics, julia to implement embedding-drift evals, suresh to flesh out migration plan and cache warmers. I'll merge into PRD and request final sign-off tomorrow morning. Thanks all :rocket:

alex: on it, will push updates and a small conformance matrix by EOD.

suresh: ack :thumbsup:
